description: Ribbon overflow control that renders a "More" button and a popup menu of commands that did not fit in the toolbar. Supports an optional search box, grouped menu items with keyboard navigation, and a no-results message.

parameters.name: IsOverflowing
parameters.description: Whether the toolbar currently has overflowed commands.

parameters.name: IsOpen
parameters.description: Whether the toolbar currently has overflowed commands.

parameters.name: MoreCommandsLabel
parameters.description: Visible text for the More button.

parameters.name: NoResultsLabel
parameters.description: Message shown when the search filter yields no commands (Fáze 18).

parameters.name: OnCommandRequested
parameters.description: Raised when the search input changes.

parameters.name: OnMenuItemKeyDown
parameters.description: Raised when a command is selected from the menu.

parameters.name: OnMoreKeyDown
parameters.description: Raised when the More button is clicked.

parameters.name: OnSearchInput
parameters.description: Raised when the More button receives a keydown event.

parameters.name: OnToggle
parameters.description: Accessible label and placeholder for the search input.

parameters.name: SearchLabel
parameters.description: Accessible label for the More commands menu.

parameters.name: SearchQuery
parameters.description: Whether the search box should be shown.

parameters.name: ShowSearch
parameters.description: Whether the overflow menu is open.
